findings.body: The audit-production-runner.py script reports NEEDS_CHANGES because bead bd-3e10j is currently in_progress. This is a bootstrap dependency that will automatically resolve to PASS once the bead is transitioned to closed/resolved.

The MoE model's final-step training loss shows high variance across seeds (0.39 to 9.78) compared to the dense matched baseline, which consistently achieves better validation bits-per-character (BPC) across all five seeds.

summary: The F-S7 production training runner bead (bd-3e10j) successfully implements the real Burn-backed MoE and dense training loops, executes the required 20,000-step training runs on Project Gutenberg for all five seeds, performs the lambda_switch sweep, and emits all 48 required support artifacts. The output artifacts have been fully validated by the repository's closure validators (validate-artifacts.py, validate-report.py, and validate-closure CLI), verifying the negative scientific verdict Fail-parity (ProceedToS8DenseOnly) where the dense baseline consistently outperforms the MoE model under matched deployed bytes.
